title: intent_reduce chunk closes leave pnl NULL: 81 of 114 rows never settled -> booked P&L omits the reduced quantity
note: MEASURED 2026-10-10 via diag journal?table=trades (6563 rows, all pages): rows with exit_reason=intent_reduce_executed n=114, pnl NULL n=81 (bybit_1 paper 66, bybit_portfolio 8, bybit_2 real_money 7). Design (execute.py:1770-1778, order_monitor.py:7999) defers chunk PnL to the local-PnL sweep / closed-pnl lookup; 33 of 114 were settled so a settler exists but 81 never were. Example: bybit_1 6532 reduced 5117.3 of 12603.6 XRP at 1.3898 vs parent 6527 entry 1.3464; parent 6527 pnl -419.98 is computed on the REMAINING 7486 units only, so about -222 USD of realized loss sits on no row. ESTIMATE (reduce fill vs parent entry x consumed over 147 allocations) = +28.7k USD unbooked across the journal, sign and size NOT verified (pyramided parents have averaged entries) - an upper-bound probe, not a figure. DONE WHEN: (1) established why the sweep skips these rows (read the settler); (2) either a backfill with provenance ESTIMATED lands or the rows are documented as intentionally excluded and the paper-book tracker and performance-review say so.
